# Prototype estimate (from the simulator)

What the simulator expects for the prototype's goal, to compare with the time it takes in game
(docs/prototype-test.md, last section). Recompute with `python3 tools/generate.py` after design changes.

Goal: 4 x robot_arm_hv, 4 x conveyor_hv, 4 x piston_hv.
Power: the real-power kit's generators, 1408 EU/t in total.

## Single-block machines only

| | |
|---|---|
| Time | **33.2 min** (1993 s), limited by machines |
| Machine time (busiest machine) | 1993 s |
| Longest chain (one item through every step) | 33 s |
| Energy | 5.90 M EU |

Machines:

- 2 x assembler LV
- 1 x assembler MV
- 2 x wiremill LV
- 2 x lathe LV
- 2 x polarizer LV
- 1 x coil_winder LV
- 1 x coil_winder MV
- 1 x bearing_press MV

## With the multiblocks

| | |
|---|---|
| Time | **16.6 min** (997 s), limited by machines |
| Machine time (busiest machine) | 997 s |
| Longest chain (one item through every step) | 33 s |
| Energy | 4.13 M EU |

Machines:

- 2 x assembler LV
- 1 x assembler MV
- 2 x wiremill LV
- 2 x lathe LV
- 2 x polarizer LV
- 1 x coil_winder LV
- 1 x coil_winder MV
- 1 x bearing_press MV
- 1 x component_assembler, aluminium frame, 4 segments
- 1 x assembly_hall, steel frame, 2 segments
- 1 x wire_drawing_line, steel frame, 2 segments
- 1 x turning_line, steel frame, 2 segments

The simulator assumes inputs are always there (AE2 keeps machines fed) and no time is lost moving
items by hand, so expect the in-game time to be longer by however long you spend setting up.
